ideas.pitch: An AI-powered simulation and optimization tool tailored for IEEE APS (Antennas and Propagation Society) challenges, using machine learning to design novel metamaterial antenna shapes for multi-band satellite communication.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the IEEE APS collaboration background of the hackathon organizers gives an edge by directly appealing to the technical domain expertise of the judging panel.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the IEEE ComSoc co-organizer theme, offering tangible engineering depth that stands out in a short 8-hour format.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the IEEE WIE (Women in Engineering) focus on societal impact and community safety, scoring high on the impact and feasibility evaluation criteria.
